requirements.title: Software Engineer
requirements.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages
Experience with SQL and databases
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)
Experience with Git / version control
Strong communication skills
requirements.requirements_block:

2. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
3. Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages
4. Experience with SQL and databases

6. Experience with Git / version control
7. Strong communication skills

decision.title: Software Engineer
decision.name: John W. Smith
decision.summary: The candidate has strong communication and management skills but lacks any relevant software engineering experience or technical qualifications. They do not meet the mandatory experience requirement or any technical requirements for this role.
decision.strengths:
Demonstrated strong communication and coordination skills.
Extensive experience in managing teams and client relationships.
decision.concerns:
No relevant software engineering or technical experience.
No technical education or evidence of programming skills.
No experience with databases, cloud platforms, or version control.
decision.email_subject: Your Software Engineer application at SmartHire
decision.email_body:
Hi John,

Thank you for your interest in the Software Engineer position at SmartHire and for the time you spent on your application. After careful review, we have decided not to move forward with your application for this role, as other candidates more closely match its current requirements.

We appreciate your interest in SmartHire and wish you every success in your search.

Best regards,
SmartHire Recruiting Team
